cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks, inspect
from hopsworks_common import job
print('schedule sig:', inspect.signature(job.Job.schedule))
print('run sig:', inspect.signature(job.Job.run))
" 2>&1 | grep -v -i warning | tail -10

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
ds = proj.get_dataset_api()
api = proj.get_job_api()
name = 'heartbeat9ec611'

# Upload script to HopsFS Resources
upload_dir = 'Resources/jobs/' + name
if not ds.exists(upload_dir):
    ds.mkdir(upload_dir)
remote = ds.upload('data/heartbeat.py', upload_dir, overwrite=True)
print('UPLOADED to', remote)

cfg = api.get_configuration('PYTHON')
cfg['appPath'] = '/Projects/' + proj.name + '/' + upload_dir + '/heartbeat.py'
job = api.create_job(name=name, config=cfg)
print('CREATED job', job.name)

# Schedule it hourly -> recurring
sched = job.schedule('0 0 * * * ?')
print('SCHEDULED:', sched.cron_expression if hasattr(sched,'cron_expression') else sched)
" 2>&1 | grep -v -i warning | tail -30
tool_input.description: Upload script, create job, schedule recurring

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
api = proj.get_job_api()
job = api.get_job('heartbeat9ec611')
print('Schedule recurring:', job.job_schedule.cron_expression, 'enabled=', job.job_schedule.enabled)
ex = job.run(await_termination=True)
print('EXECUTION state:', ex.state, 'final_status:', ex.final_status)
" 2>&1 | grep -v -i warning | tail -20
